en.content:
Create a reference image in Film Studio’s 3D Shot Composer by placing 3D figures and setting the composition (the man in the foreground, the ghost behind on the left) and camera position, then use that image as a reference image in Seedance 2.5 to control the intended expression.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Using the 3D Shot Composer in Film Studio

Create 3D figures.
Place the man in the foreground, the ghost behind on the left.
Leave the camera fixed there.

By using that image as a reference,
I was able to achieve an expression very close to what I wanted.

Seedance 2.5 can produce amazing results,
but it’s quite expensive.
Among the options available right now, the best cost performance is
